definition: A buildspec is a YAML document containing the commands and settings for a build.
YAML is the structured text format used to express a CodeBuild buildspec.
A build environment combines an operating system, language runtime, and tools used to run build commands.
A container image supplies the software environment in which build commands run.
A runtime provides the language environment selected for running build software.
A phase is a named stage of build execution with its own commands and result.
A shell executes command text and holds command state such as the current directory.
An exit status is the result returned by a command and included in build error context when available.
A regular expression is a text pattern used to match error messages or webhook fields.
An environment variable is a named value available to build commands.
An ARN is an identifier that names an AWS resource.
An artifact is a set of files passed between actions in a pipeline.
A namespace groups the output variables of a pipeline action so later actions can reference them.
A report group collects report runs and shares settings such as permissions and export configuration.
Line coverage measures the statements exercised by tests.
Branch coverage measures the control-flow branches exercised by tests.
A cache stores build components for reuse in later builds.
A cache key identifies a stored S3 cache copy.
A service role is an IAM role that a service uses to perform authorized operations on your behalf.
A trust policy specifies which principals may assume an IAM role.
A VPC is a virtual network isolated from other virtual networks in AWS.
A subnet is a range of IP addresses within a VPC.
A security group controls traffic allowed to and from associated resources.
NAT provides outbound internet access for VPC build interfaces without public IP addresses.
A gateway endpoint adds a route to a supported AWS service without requiring a NAT device.
A webhook delivers repository event information that CodeBuild can filter to start a build.
A pull request proposes source branch changes for review before merging.
A fork is a copy of a repository used to propose changes back to the original repository.
A commit SHA identifies the source revision approved for a pull request build.
The Docker daemon is the process used to build and run Docker containers.
Privileged mode grants the Docker permissions required for VPC Docker builds and local Docker layer caching.
A Docker layer is a reusable part of a container image that local Docker caching can retain.
A key policy controls access to a KMS key used for artifact encryption.
A SecureString parameter has a plain parameter name and an encrypted value.
A metric dimension identifies the project whose CodeBuild metrics you want to inspect.
